entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Lack of control and direction of framework #37758

Closed

  • Precompiled queries: use InterceptableLocation rather than InterceptsLocationAttribute when creating interceptors for operations in precompiled queries #35483
    11.0.0
  • Command-line tools should adhere to stdout/stderr conventions #22878
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37759
  • Backport: Use InterceptableLocation for precompiled query interceptor generation (release/10.0) #37756
  • Github agentic workflow for backporting servicing PRs #37755
  • [release/10.0] Fix owned entities with default values not saved in TPH with shared columns #37751

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37749
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37757
  • Route dotnet-ef diagnostic output to stderr, fix premature help exit code #37744
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37753
  • [TINY] Use InterceptableLocation for precompiled query interceptor generation #37734
  • Introduce relational EF.Functions.JsonPathExists #37732
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37752

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Restore ordinals when transitioning complex collection entries from Deleted state #37729
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Fix named query filter conventions #37738
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Fix ArgumentOutOfRangeException when deleting from a complex collection with nested collections #37702
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Fix InvalidCastException in OriginalValues.ToObject() with nested nullable complex properties #37703
  • [release/10.0] Fix projection of entities with complex collections through subqueries #37747
  • Add support for BigInteger, Int128, and UInt128 in SqliteValueBinder #37492
    community-contribution
  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
